correctness.rationale: Torus invariance diagonalizes the cap-restriction operator in orthogonal degree-d monomials, with normalized squared moduli Dirichlet(alpha_j+1). Transferring one exponent from any outside coordinate to cap coordinate strictly increases cap probability by conditional beta monotone likelihood ratios. With all degree in the two cap coordinates, condition on their sum S~Beta(d+2,n-2), and use the strictly monotone symmetrized Beta(a+1,b+1) imbalance likelihood ratio to order every (a,d-a) concentration. The two pure powers are the unique top eigenspace and the nearest imbalance gives the second level. Direct comparison of the conditional beta central interval for (d,0) versus (d-1,1) integrates to the stated positive beta integral, giving sharp stability.
risk: The proof needs strictness also when t approaches 0 or 1; for each 0<t<1 there remains an open positive S interval.
This is holomorphic degree exactly d, not all spherical harmonics nor unequal/more than two caps.
